paper_title: Context Consistency between Training and Testing in Simultaneous Machine   Translation

model_annotation: The plot illustrates the relationship between average lagging and BLEU score for four different conditions. The x-axis is labeled "Average Lagging (AL)" with a linear scale ranging from 1 to 8, and tick labels at integer values. The y-axis is labeled "BLEU" with a linear scale ranging from 20 to 30, and tick labels at even integer values. A purple, dashed line with a circular marker represents "Consistency-CE"; it begins at 22.3 at x=1 and increases to 27.4 at x=8. A blue, dashed line with a square marker represents "Inconsistency-CE," starting at 22.2 at x=1 and reaching 28.2 at x=8. A dark blue, solid line with a square marker represents "Inconsistency-CE-MP," beginning at 25.4 at x=1 and increasing to 29.4 at x=8. Finally, a red, dashed line with a star marker represents "Consistency-Bi," starting at 25.1 at x=1 and rising to 29.6 at x=8.
